info.name: ViewContent
info.title: Content viewer
info.description: Generic single-item, list and tree viewer for content types.
info.author: Kami team

content_types.title: Content types
content_types.description: Content types available to this viewer instance. Leave empty to use all content types enabled in ViewContent.

parent_id.title: List parent item
parent_id.description: Optional parent used when the single-item view falls back to a list.

items_per_page.title: Items per page
items_per_page.description: Number of items in fallback list view. Use 0 to display all items.

show_pagination.title: Show pagination
show_pagination.description: Display pagination controls in fallback list view.

sort_field.title: Sort field
sort_field.description: Optional field used to sort items across all selected content types. Missing values are placed last.

sort_direction.title: Sort direction
sort_direction.description: Sort direction for the selected sort field.

content_types.title: Content types
content_types.description: Content types available to this viewer instance. Leave empty to use all content types enabled in ViewContent.

parent_id.title: Parent item
parent_id.description: Optional parent item. When set, only its direct children are listed.

items_per_page.title: Items per page
items_per_page.description: Number of items displayed per page. Use 0 to display all items.

show_pagination.title: Show pagination
show_pagination.description: Display pagination controls for this list.

sort_field.title: Sort field
sort_field.description: Optional field used to sort items across all selected content types. Missing values are placed last.

sort_direction.title: Sort direction
sort_direction.description: Sort direction for the selected sort field.

content_types.title: Content types
content_types.description: Content types included in the tree. Leave empty to use all content types enabled in ViewContent.

parent_id.title: Tree root item
parent_id.description: Optional root anchor. The root itself is not rendered; its children become the first tree level.

tree_mode.title: Tree loading mode
tree_mode.description: Full renders the complete tree. Lazy loads closed branches through AJAX when first opened.

sort_field.title: Sort field
sort_field.description: Optional field used to sort sibling items across all selected content types. Missing values are placed last.

sort_direction.title: Sort direction
sort_direction.description: Sort direction for the selected sort field.
